headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins in a 13-1 victory, with Rafael Flores Jr. hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson of the Seattle Mariners is on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation. Davis Martin of the Chicago White Sox has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister. Matt Chapman of the San Francisco Giants has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald of the San Francisco Giants has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock of the Boston Red Sox is on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. James Outman of the Detroit Tigers is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Endy Rodríguez of the Pittsburgh Pirates is on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge White Sox in Thrilling 9-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, outscoring them 9-8. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after 6.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki had a notable performance for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in 1-0 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins in a low-scoring matchup. Chase Burns was instrumental in the Reds' win, showcasing his skills on the mound.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
